title: Vehicle documents
description: Registrations, inspections and taxes with their expiry

help.title: About vehicle documents
help.overview: Keep each car's papers here, with scans. Documents without an expiry date never trigger a reminder.

sections.title: On this page
items: Chosen staff are notified once, 30 days before a document expires.
Expired documents are marked every morning.
A newer document of the same type takes over the old one's reminder.
